entries.brief: A compact dense mustard-yellow and olive vapor cloud rises from a tiny cracked spoiled egg, rounded cloudy silhouette, unpleasant haze. No skull, blood, injury, corrosive liquid or explosion. Original full-color SKAZ fantasy handbook painted icon, sculpted broad shapes, dark slate contours, warm highlights, natural restrained colors. One compact clear motif entirely within central65 percent square canvas, wide transparent empty margins, readable32px and grayscale circle. No text, digits, UI, frame or backdrop. Transparent PNG.

review.notes: Local IAB32/40px, grayscale circle, Polaris/Coal/Atlas. Eight final motifs inspected in all three themes at32/40px and in grayscale circles. Web anchors, water breathing versus walking and wind barrier remain distinct.
